agenda_items.title: Flood Control Strategy Update – 46th Street and 1st Avenue Intersection [EUCS2026-0603]
agenda_items.recommendation: That the ninth Flood Control Strategy Project be approved; and That the detailed design and construction of the storm sewer along 46th Street East from 1st Avenue North to the RCAF Memorial Storm Pond proceed to mitigate flooding near the intersection of 46th Street East and 1st Avenue North during intense storm events.

agenda_items.title: 210 Pacific Avenue – Extension of Timeframe for Emergency Residential Shelter [GPC2023-1002, CC2024-0202]
agenda_items.content: Director of Planning and Development Anderson presented the report with a PowerPoint and responded to questions of Council.
agenda_items.recommendation: That City Council authorize: The use of 210 Pacific Avenue for the purpose of providing an Emergency Residential Shelter, as a temporary use, from October 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027, as outlined in the report of the Community Services Division; dated June 24, 2026; That the City of Saskatoon extend the lease agreement with the Saskatchewan Housing Corporation for 210 Pacific Avenue, for the purpose of providing a temporary Emergency Residential Shelter, based on the existing terms; That an 8-month extension to the property tax exemption be granted to Saskatchewan Housing Corporation for 210 Pacific Avenue, continuing from October 1, 2026, onwards; and That the City Solicitor be requested to prepare the necessary tax exemption bylaw and agreements and the Mayor and the City Clerk be authorized to execute the agreements under the Corporate Seal.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (11) Councillor Davies, Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Donauer, Mayor Block, Councillor Dubois, Councillor Kelleher, Councillor Ford, Councillor MacDonald, Councillor Parker, Councillor Pearce, and Councillor Timon CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY (11 to 0)
